instruction: Delete all stored cookies from Amazon.com to prevent them from tracking my activity.

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting stored Amazon cookies to prevent tracking. Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly reads Chrome's actual cookie database using SQLite query
Metric logic properly checks for absence of Amazon cookies (returns 1.0 if none found)
Domain matching uses compare_urls function which should handle variations like '.amazon.com', 'www.amazon.com', etc.
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure cookies are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: verifies the sole requirement (Amazon cookies deleted)
Expected domain '.amazon.com' correctly matches all Amazon subdomains
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Cookie tuple index assumption at line 435 (cookie[1]) assumes specific SQLite column order - this is standard for Chrome's cookie schema but could be more explicit
Consider adding error handling if cookie database is locked or inaccessible
